minutes.headline: Open Space Committee elected a vice chair and clerk, then heard heated neighbor opposition to a possible Parmenter Road car-top launch.
minutes.summary: The committee named a vice chair and a clerk by roll call. It heard that the title exam on the Lake Shirley Reservoir parcel was inconclusive, so the chair will seek Town Council advice. Most of the meeting was Parks Commission interest in the Parmenter Road lot for car-top boat access, and neighbors raised safety, parking, trailer and ADA concerns. No transfer or recommendation was decided; the item may return February 8.

what_happened.line: The Open Space Committee named a vice chair and a clerk by roll call vote, with one member absent.
The title exam on the Lake Shirley Reservoir parcel was inconclusive, so the chair will seek time with Town Council and the town manager.
Neighbors opposed a possible car-top boat launch at the Parmenter Road lot, citing parking, safety, trailers, accessibility and wetland buffers; no transfer or recommendation was decided.
The Parmenter Road idea is likely to return on the February 8 agenda, with the chair compiling the concerns heard.

why_it_matters: Any change of use for the Parmenter Road lot would be a town land decision, and the committee has not recommended one, so residents near the lot have time to weigh in before anything reaches a vote.
The cost and legal path to acquiring the Lake Shirley Reservoir parcel are still unknown until Town Council advises, so no money request tied to it exists yet.
